title: Exclusive report operation
responsibility: Runs an asynchronous report update under an exclusive lock file.

inputs.name: reportLock.directory
inputs.description: Existing report directory where the lock file is created.

inputs.name: reportLock.operation
inputs.description: Async operation to run after acquiring the lock.

outputs.name: reportLock
outputs.description: Promise resolving to the operation result. Tries exclusive lock creation up to 200 times, with 25-millisecond delays. An older-than-five-second lock with a valid PID is removed only if that process no longer exists. The lock is closed and removed after the operation.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with Report is busy; retry this update after exhausting attempts. Other filesystem and operation errors propagate.
